user.current_work: Social media manager at a local agency

user_snapshot: Two years post-NYSC, agency social media manager in Yaba earning ₦150k with ₦450k saved, committed to japa within 18 months, high risk tolerance, no dependents.
headline_insight: You're in the sweet spot most agency SMMs miss: your ₦150k agency salary is a floor, not a ceiling — remote USD content/marketing roles pay 4-8x that, and your japa commitment means the next 18 months should be about stacking dollar income + portfolio, not chasing another Lagos agency title.

routes.title: Remote Content/Social Marketer for Global Startups (USD)
routes.one_liner: Leverage your agency experience into a $1.5k-4k/mo remote role at a US/EU startup, fully location-independent.

fit_reasons.note: Social media management + content creation + video editing + writing is exactly the stack remote B2B startups hire for.
High risk tolerance + ₦450k savings + no dependents means you can afford 3-4 months of focused applying.

break_reasons.risk: Junior remote content market is saturated — without a niche (B2B SaaS, fintech, DevTools) you drown in 500-applicant pools.

routes.who_this_fits: Writers who pick a vertical (SaaS, crypto, fintech) and build visible proof-of-work on Twitter/LinkedIn for 3-6 months before applying.
routes.who_this_breaks: Generalists who cold-apply on LinkedIn without a portfolio site or niche — they get ghosted for 9 months straight.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and weekends for 6 months building portfolio pieces and a Twitter presence while still at the agency.

real_pay.range_note: USD-pegged: entry $1.5k/mo, mid $3k, senior $5k+. Converted at ₦1,500/$. FX swings change naira figures but dollar stays stable.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you niche into B2B SaaS content, you're earning $2.5-3.5k/mo (₦3.7-5.2m) remotely from Lagos, have ₦8m+ saved, and are choosing between Canada Express Entry and staying remote indefinitely.
pro_tips: Pick one vertical (fintech or DevTools) and write weekly on LinkedIn.
Apply via Pallet, Contra, and Superpath — not LinkedIn cold.

monday_actions.step: Create Superpath and Pallet profiles; both curate content marketing roles invisible on LinkedIn.
Pick one vertical (B2B SaaS or fintech) and ship one LinkedIn post analyzing a brand's content strategy.
DM 5 Nigerians already in remote content roles (search 'Content Marketer' + 'Lagos' on LinkedIn) for 15-min calls.

milestones: Build Notion portfolio with 3 spec pieces
Land $1.5-2.5k/mo part-time or full-time remote role

routes.nigerian_notes: Payoneer + Grey for USD receipt. Nigerian tax: register as sole proprietor once above ₦25m/yr. Flutterwave Send works for smaller contracts.

routes.title: Canada Study Permit → PGWP → PR (Comms/Marketing Masters)
routes.one_liner: One-year Canadian Masters in Communications/Digital Media, then 3-year Post-Graduate Work Permit, then Express Entry PR.

fit_reasons.note: Your committed japa appetite + 18-month horizon aligns with a Fall 2026 intake application starting now.
Single with zero dependents makes the proof-of-funds + study permit approval dramatically easier than for family applicants.

break_reasons.risk: ₦450k savings is nowhere near the ₦10-15m needed for tuition deposit + GIC + proof of funds; you need a parent/family co-sponsor or 12 months of aggressive saving.

routes.who_this_fits: Grads with family willing to unlock ₦8-12m, or who can stack remote USD income fast enough to self-fund within 12-15 months.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone relying on part-time Canadian work to cover tuition — the math doesn't work with current fee structures.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦12m+ capital (mostly family or loans), Lagos network, 12-18 months in a student bubble before work starts.

real_pay.range_note: Post-PGWP: CAD 55-80k entry comms roles in Toronto/Calgary = ₦3.5-5m/mo at ₦1,100/CAD. Senior marketing CAD 120k+.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you start the funding push now, you're finishing an MA in Digital Media at Ryerson/Seneca/Humber, working part-time at CAD $18/hr, and 6 months from a full-time comms role at CAD 60k (₦4m/mo).
pro_tips: Target 1-year Masters at Humber, Seneca, Centennial — cheaper than big universities.
SOP must explain why Canada specifically, not generic 'quality education' lines.

monday_actions.step: Book IELTS Academic for 6-8 weeks out via British Council Lagos — aim for 7+ overall.
Shortlist 5 Canadian post-graduate diploma programs in Digital Media/PR at Humber, Seneca, George Brown, Centennial.
Have the ₦12m funding conversation with family in writing, or model self-funding from 12 months of remote USD work.

routes.nigerian_notes: SDS is gone — standard study permit approval is ~50-60% for strong profiles. Second Class Upper from private uni is acceptable but SOP and funds clarity matter more than GPA.

routes.title: Niche Content Creator → Personal Brand Business
routes.one_liner: Build a niche Nigerian content brand (tech, finance, career) on TikTok/YouTube/Twitter, monetize via brand deals, courses, consulting.

fit_reasons.note: Content creation + video editing + writing is the full stack a solo creator needs — most creators lack two of three.
Low family pressure means you can tolerate 9-12 months of low monetization while audience compounds.

break_reasons.risk: Creator income in Nigeria is power-law distributed — 90% earn under ₦100k/mo from content even after 2 years of posting.

routes.who_this_fits: Creators who pick a B2B or high-CPM niche (fintech, career, tech) and ship 3x/week consistently for 18 months.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone chasing virality in entertainment/lifestyle niches — low brand deal value, burnout fast.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Weekends and 15 hrs/week for 18 months; possibly the stability of agency income if you go full-time too early.

real_pay.range_note: Highly variable. Senior niche creators (Fisayo Fosudo, Nicole Explores) earn ₦3-8m/mo. Median creator after 2 years: ₦300-700k.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you pick a niche like 'remote work for Nigerians' or 'career in tech', you have 30-80k followers, earn ₦800k-1.5m/mo from brand deals + a paid community, and use the platform as japa leverage.
pro_tips: Niche down to one audience intersection — e.g. 'SMM for Nigerian fintechs'.
Pitch brand deals directly via email; don't wait for inbound.

monday_actions.step: Pick one niche and publish a pinned manifesto post on Twitter/LinkedIn and first video on TikTok this week.
Join Creators Corner Nigeria and The Creator Economy WhatsApp groups via Twitter DM to known members.
Commit to a 90-day content schedule: 3 videos/week, 5 Twitter posts/week, tracked in Notion.

routes.nigerian_notes: Brand deals route through agencies like Passionate PR, Plaqad, Anakle. TikTok Creator Fund doesn't pay Nigerians — revenue comes from brand deals + info products.

routes.title: Senior Social Media / Growth Marketer at Lagos Fintech or Media Co
routes.one_liner: Jump from agency to in-house senior SMM/growth role at a Nigerian fintech, media company, or scale-up earning ₦450-800k/mo.

fit_reasons.note: 2 years agency SMM + content + video editing is exactly the profile fintechs like Kuda, Moniepoint, Piggyvest hire for.
Yaba, Lagos puts you inside the fintech/media hiring corridor — no relocation needed for Paystack, Flutterwave, Piggyvest, Big Cabal.

break_reasons.risk: This anchors you in naira when you're committed to japa; senior Lagos roles make relocation psychologically harder even when financially easier.

routes.who_this_fits: Grads who want a 12-18 month stability + savings sprint before japa, and want a prestige Nigerian employer on the CV.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone who'll get comfortable at ₦500k and let the japa plan drift into year 3 and 4.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Agency variety and creative freedom; in-house work is one brand, deeper politics, longer feedback loops.

real_pay.range_note: Fintech top tier (Paystack, Flutterwave, Moniepoint) pays 20-40% above media/FMCG. Some roles include USD component.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you land a senior SMM role at a tier-1 fintech, you're earning ₦700-900k/mo, have ₦8-12m saved toward Canada/UK japa funds, and have a portfolio no agency grad can match.
pro_tips: Apply directly via company careers pages — fintech recruiters ignore Jobberman postings.
Warm intro via Big Cabal/TechCabal alumni beats cold application 10x.

monday_actions.step: Apply to open Social Media / Growth roles at Piggyvest, Cowrywise, Moniepoint, Kuda, Bamboo via their careers pages.
DM 3 current fintech marketers on LinkedIn asking about their hiring process — referrals triple callback rates.
Build a 1-page case study of a Nigerian fintech's social strategy with your critique + 90-day plan; attach to applications.

milestones: Start IELTS for japa parallel track

routes.nigerian_notes: Fintech hiring slowed in 2024-2025 but 2026 is thawing. Watch Techpoint Africa and Benjamindada.com newsletters for funding news — companies that just raised are actively hiring.

routes_filtered_out.reason: Hard no on commission-only sales. Excluded per intake.
Hard no on MLM. Excluded per intake.
Ignores your existing 4-skill content stack; restarting from zero as a junior dev in a saturated 2026 market is a 2+ year detour when you already have leverage.

routes_filtered_out.route: UK Skilled Worker Visa (direct employer sponsorship)
routes_filtered_out.reason: Post-2024 reform requires £38,700 salary floor; almost no UK agencies sponsor Nigerian SMMs at that band. Canada study route is the realistic japa path.
Two years post-NYSC you're outside the graduate trainee window, and Mass Comm isn't the preferred pipeline degree.
